IC2: Person is a unilateral transfemoral or knee-disarticulation amputee with stabilized residual limb.
IC3: Person is a K2, K3 or K4 ambulator based on Medicare Functional Classification Level (MFCL).
IC4: Person is currently fitted with a prosthesis [AND] using a non-microprocessor controlled prosthetic knee for at least 6 months.
IC5: Person was [NOT] never fitted with microprocessor controlled prosthetic knee joint.
IC6: Person is willing and able to independently provide informed consent.
IC7: Person is willing to comply with study procedures.
IC8: Person wears prosthesis daily and = 8 hours/day.
IC10: Person is walking not slower than 3km/h (~0.8m/s) (based on 10m walk test conducted during recruiting).
IC11: Person is walking on level ground in a step over step manner.
